question: The 'Make in India' initiative primarily focuses on which sector?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manufacturing**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The 'Make in India' initiative was launched by the Government of India in September 2014.
 
• It aims to transform India into a global manufacturing hub by encouraging both multinational and domestic companies to manufacture their products within the country.
 
• Key sectors focused on include automobiles, chemicals, IT, pharmaceuticals, textiles, ports, aviation, leather, tourism, hospitality, wellness, railways, and more.
